d.ko: In Love Love Mystery Club, you’re the newest member of the Detective Club at a seemingly ordinary high school. Through Full Motion Video (FMV) storytelling, your choices steer the narrative—will your heart find tenderness… or will hidden horrors emerge from the darkness?
d.en: In Love Love Mystery Club, you’re the newest member of the Detective Club at a seemingly ordinary high school. Through Full Motion Video (FMV) storytelling, your choices steer the narrative—will your heart find tenderness… or will hidden horrors emerge from the darkness?
d.zh: 在《Love Love Mystery Club》中，你将成为一所看似普通高中的侦探社新成员。通过全动态影像（FMV）叙事，你的选择将引导故事走向——你的心会找到温柔，还是潜藏的恐怖将从黑暗中浮现？
